title: AWS Backup extends logically air-gapped vault support to six additional AWS Regions
summary: Discover more about what's new at AWS with AWS Backup extends logically air-gapped vault support to six additional AWS Regions
body_markdown:
AWS Backup logically air-gapped vaults are now available in six additional AWS Regions: Asia Pacific (Taipei), Asia Pacific (Malaysia), Asia Pacific (New Zealand), Asia Pacific (Thailand), Mexico (Central), and Canada West (Calgary).


With logically air-gapped vaults now available in these Regions, you can store immutable, isolated backups that are locked by default and encrypted using AWS owned keys or customer-managed keys. You can back up directly to logically air-gapped vaults, copy backups across accounts and Regions, share vaults for recovery using AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM), and safeguard vault access during account compromise using Multi-party approval.


To get started, visit the AWS Backup console, AWS Command Line Interface (CLI), or AWS SDKs. For a complete list of supported Regions and features, visit the[AWS Backup documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/backup-feature-availability.html#features-by-region) . To learn more about logically air-gapped vaults, visit the[feature documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/logicallyairgappedvault.html) and[pricing page](https://aws.amazon.com/backup/pricing/) .
